messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
orchard_road | Orchard Road | 0 | 120 | 10:00-22:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
gardens_domes | Flower Dome and Cloud Forest | 46 | 120 | 09:00-21:00 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
orchard_road: cable_car 20, gardens_domes 21, haw_par_villa 25
cable_car: orchard_road 20, gardens_domes 23, haw_par_villa 21
gardens_domes: orchard_road 21, cable_car 23, haw_par_villa 32
haw_par_villa: orchard_road 25, cable_car 21, gardens_domes 32

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

Hey, I’ve got some free time from 09:00 to 14:10 and a budget of S$47. I really need to hit up Orchard Road, Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. If I can fit them in, I’d also love to see Singapore Cable Car and Haw Par Villa. 

I need to do Orchard Road before the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. For Orchard Road, I can’t get there before 10:00 and I need to be finished by 11:50. Then for Flower Dome and Cloud Forest, I need to spend 90 minutes there, arriving no earlier than 11:50 and finishing by 14:55. Also, I’d like to spend 75 minutes at Singapore Cable Car.
